punchline: Tim Ferriss picked the title of his bestseller by running the options as Google ads and seeing which one strangers clicked.
thirty_sec: Tim Ferriss says don't build a product until you know people want it. Put up a simple page, buy a few small Google ads, and count who clicks and tries to order. Nobody gets charged; they're told it's unavailable. He even named his book that way, running possible titles as ads and keeping the one people clicked most. That's how The 4-Hour Workweek got its name.
question: What's an idea you've been sure about that you've never actually tested on strangers?
